newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek socialists lead in election, exit polls.
newsitem.headline: Greek socialists lead in election, exit polls.

text.p: Greece's ruling socialist party took a strong early lead in Sunday's national elections, according to three separate exit polls by Greek television channels.

MEGA channel gave the ruling socialists 42 percent and the opposition conservatives 38 percent. Skai TV gave the socialists 41.6 percent and the conservatives 38.7 percent. Antenna TV gave the socialists 41.5 percent and the conservatives 38.4 percent.

Antenna said its figure, if confirmed, would give the ruling Panhellenic Socialist Movement (PASOK) more than 159 deputies in the 300-seat parliament. That would be down from its present 170 seats but still a clear absolute majority.
All three exit polls showed four smaller parties entering the parliament.
